name: St. Cecelia Sing (parish music concert)

raw: Sunday, November 22, 2026, 2:00 PM. St. Cecelia Sing: Join us for St. Cecelia Sing! on Sunday, November 22, at 2 PM in the Church. Our entire music ministry, including the Adult Choir, Children's Choir, Bell Choir, and special guests, will come together for a joyful, hour-long concert honoring St. Cecelia, the patron saint of music. All ages are welcome!
